data.name: Marriott Executive Apartments Panama City, Finisterre
data.address: Calle Colombia & Calle Republica del Paraguay Panama City, Panamá Province, Panama
data.description:
Set in the lively Bella Vista district, this upscale apartment hotel is 4 km from both the National Theatre of Panama and the Panama Interoceanic Canal Museum.
Featuring wood floors, the modern studios offer kitchens, dining tables, and sitting areas with sofabeds. They also have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, iPod docks and laptop-sized safes. Apartments with 1 or 2 bedrooms add separate living spaces. Room service is offered.
A casual restaurant serves international cuisine and free breakfast. Other amenities include a gym and an outdoor pool. Parking is included.
